sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

The petitioner whose property has come under acquisition undertaken under the National Highways Act, 1956 in the form of Award no. Coll/Def/2021/124-25 dated 26.04.2021 passed by the Collector Land Acquisition Defence, Rajouri- Poonch, HQ Rajouri, being dissatisfied with the quantum of compensation assessed approached the competent authority by an application in terms of sub section 5 of 3-G but the petitioner is finding that the matter is not being referred to arbitrator for adjudication under sub section 6 of 3-G and, accordingly, the present writ petition.

entities.text: Collector Land Acquisition Defence, Rajouri- Poonch
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Petitioner to furnish registered postal covers for the service of respondents within a period of 7 days,
whereupon the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to issue notice to the respondents.

Registrar Judicial,
Jammu shall be entitled to extend time for furnishing of registered postal covers if not submitted within time given.
List along with WP(C) no. 2457/2023 on 12.02.2024.
